Harrace, the honest breakdown. Loom is an async video messaging platform. Hit record, talk over your screen, get a sharable link, no meeting required. Atlassian acquired Loom in 2023 for $975 million. And since then, the product has deepened its AI features while also picking up real reliability complaints. Recording issues is currently the single most common complaint with crashes during recording, failed uploads, and audio that drifts out of sync with video the further into a recording you get. Loom's own support documentation now recommends enabling a fallback recorder as a workaround, which is a strange thing for a screen recorder to need.
